# camunda_clusters (Data Source)

Read all clusters of the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "camunda_clusters" "all" {}

output "healthy_clusters" {
  value = [
    for cluster in data.camunda_clusters.all.clusters : cluster.name
    if cluster.status == "Healthy"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (Attributes List) The clusters of the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))
- `id` (String) Always `clusters`.

<a id="nestedatt--clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters`

Read-Only:

- `auto_update` (Boolean) Whether Camunda upgrades the cluster automatically.
- `backup_region` (String) ID of the region that stores the cluster's backups. Null if the cluster has none.
- `channel` (String) ID of the cluster's channel
- `created` (String) When the cluster was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `description` (String) Description of the cluster. Null if it has none.
- `encryption` (String) Type of the key that encrypts the cluster's data: `Software`, `Hardware`, `Provider` or `External`.
- `encryption_status` (String) State of the cluster's encryption. Only reported when `encryption` is `External`.
- `generation` (String) ID of the generation the cluster currently runs
- `id` (String) Cluster ID
- `labels` (List of String) Labels of the cluster, as reported by the Console.
- `links` (Attributes) URLs of the cluster's components. A component the cluster doesn't have has an empty URL. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters--links))
- `name` (String) The name of the cluster
- `owner_id` (String) ID of the user or client that owns the cluster.
- `plan_type` (String) ID of the cluster's plan type
- `region` (String) ID of the cluster's region
- `status` (String) Status of the cluster, such as `Healthy` or `Suspended`.

<a id="nestedatt--clusters--links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters.links`

Read-Only:

- `connectors` (String) Connectors URL.
- `console` (String) URL of the cluster in Console.
- `identity` (String) Identity URL.
- `oauth` (String) OAuth token URL.
- `operate` (String) Operate URL.
- `optimize` (String) Optimize URL.
- `tasklist` (String) Tasklist URL.
- `zeebe` (String) Zeebe gateway URL.
